manifest.name: gdn-q4k-fp8-mid24-35-unsloth-mlp0-27-lmhead
manifest.description: The recurrent Q4_K map with the FP8 band 24-35 and lm_head fitted once (#66: RP-KL 0.1100, decode 93.4, prefill 13.6K, peak 22.08 GiB, holdout PASS), plus the attested calibrated NVFP4 bytes on MLP layers 0-27 that lowered drift by about 0.009 on top of the band in #65. The calibrated bytes are NVFP4 like the shipped ones, so kernels, decode, prefill and memory stay those of #66, about 0.3 GiB below #65; the drift gain of the early calibrated MLP should carry over as it did on the shipped recurrent map. Layer 0 of the recurrent path, attention and MLP layers 28-63 keep the shipped bytes.
